description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830116 (23/0218)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extent, owners' details, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
